answers.company: DigiScaler is a premium digital products brand that provides downloadable website optimization kits, business templates, conversion checklists, and growth resources for online businesses.
answers.services: DigiScaler sells downloadable resources such as website optimization kits, checkout readiness checklists, landing page templates, business audit templates, UX clarity resources, and growth planning documents — see Resources for the full list.
answers.pricing: Published USD kits: Starter Website Kit — $9.99; Growth Optimization Kit — $19.99; Pro Conversion Toolkit — $29.99; Scale Business Bundle — $49.99. Each tier stacks more templates and bundles — see Pricing for details.
answers.website_design: Our kits include practical guides and templates focused on clear layout, readability, and credible structure you can apply to your own site.
answers.ecommerce: Growth-tier-and-up materials cover product pages, checkout clarity checklists, and customer-journey prompts — all as downloadable resources.
answers.landing_page: Landing Page Templates are included among the resource types described on the Resources page.
answers.audit: Business audit templates and website audit documents are part of the downloadable kits — worksheets you complete yourself, not a human-delivered review.
answers.uiux: UX clarity resources in the bundles highlight friction points and improvements you can implement yourself.
answers.digital_products: Every purchase is a digital download or bundle (PDFs, sheets, Notion files, ZIP packs) with automated delivery and secure digital access after checkout.
answers.process: Typical flow: choose a kit on Pricing, complete checkout, then download files from secure links or email. Everything is self-service.
answers.contact: For product support, type "support" here or use the Product Support form on the Contact page.
answers.languages: We support English, Arabic, and French — switch languages from the header. The DigiScaler brand name stays in Roman characters.
answers.checkout_resources: Checkout readiness checklists and trust-focused PDFs are included in the kits so you can improve clarity on your own site.
answers.payment_no_guarantee: DigiScaler does not guarantee sales, revenue, rankings, or specific business results. Resources are educational tools; outcomes depend on how you use them.
answers.refund: Digital products follow the Refund Policy. Eligibility may depend on download/access status — mistaken or duplicate payments may be reviewed case by case.
answers.timeline: Support replies within about 24–48 business hours. Digital access is delivered right after successful purchase unless email providers delay messages.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.headline: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: DigiScaler LLC ("we", "our", or "us") describes—at a general level—how information may be handled when you use this website or purchase digital products. This summary is not legal advice.
privacyPage.legalDisclaimer: This page is for general information and should not be considered legal advice. Consult qualified counsel for your situation.

sections.title: Information we may collect
sections.content: We may collect details you voluntarily provide, such as name, email, order references, product notes, and similar fields submitted through contact flows or purchases. Technical data like IP address, device type, or browser may be collected automatically by hosting or infrastructure providers.

sections.title: Contact form data
sections.content: If you use a website form, the fields you submit are used only to respond to product support or related requests. Avoid sharing highly sensitive information inside form fields unless necessary.

sections.title: Payments handled by third parties
sections.content: Payments are processed by third-party providers. We do not store full payment card numbers on our own servers. Those providers process transactions under their own terms and privacy policies.

sections.title: Cookies & basic analytics
sections.content: The site may use cookies or similar technologies for basic functionality or aggregated analytics (for example understanding traffic patterns). You can manage cookies through your browser; disabling them may limit some features.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.content: We use information to respond to inquiries, deliver purchased digital products, improve site reliability, protect against abuse, and communicate about orders or support tickets. We do not sell personal data for unrelated marketing.

sections.title: How data may be shared
sections.content: We may share limited data with infrastructure, payment, or email-delivery vendors strictly as needed to operate the business. We do not share information for independent marketing by those vendors beyond their role as processors.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.content: We retain business records and customer communications only as long as needed to fulfill orders, meet legal obligations, or resolve disputes.

sections.title: Security
sections.content: We apply reasonable safeguards appropriate to a digital products business, but no online system is perfectly secure. You share information at your own considered risk.

sections.title: Your rights & requests
sections.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete certain personal data. Contact us using the email below and we will respond in a reasonable timeframe.

sections.title: Changes
sections.content: We may update this policy as practices evolve. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date above and posting the revised text on this page.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Questions about privacy practices: support@degiscaler.com

sections.title: Use of website
sections.content: You agree to use this site lawfully and without attempting to disrupt its operation. Content is provided for information about DigiScaler LLC; copying or scraping without permission is not allowed.

sections.content: DigiScaler LLC sells downloadable digital products (such as PDF guides, templates, checklists, Notion resources, spreadsheets, and ZIP bundles) as described on each product page. Delivery is electronic—typically via secure digital access and/or email—after checkout completes. Products are self-service resources; they are not individualized professional services and do not constitute legal, tax, or financial advice. DigiScaler does not guarantee sales, revenue, rankings, conversion rates, traffic, or other business outcomes.

sections.title: No outcome guarantees
sections.content: Resources are educational and practical tools. Your results depend on implementation, market conditions, product-market fit, website quality, and many factors outside our control.

sections.title: Payment & pricing
sections.content: Published prices are in USD unless stated otherwise. Payment is required before digital delivery. Third-party payment providers handle card data; their terms also apply.

sections.title: Customer responsibilities
sections.content: You must provide accurate contact details, safeguard download links, and use purchased materials lawfully. Misuse, redistribution contrary to license terms, or fraudulent purchases may lead to suspended access.

sections.title: Product scope
sections.content: Each listing describes included files and tiers. Higher tiers stack additional downloads as stated. Unless expressly stated, purchases do not include custom work.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.content: Digital products are licensed for your internal business use as described at purchase. Redistribution, resale, or public republishing may be restricted—follow the usage terms included with each bundle.

sections.title: Digital delivery
sections.content: Products are deemed delivered when downloadable files or access links are made available as described. Refunds, where applicable, follow the Refund Policy.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, DigiScaler LLC is not liable for indirect or consequential damages. Aggregate liability relating to a given purchase is limited to fees paid for that product unless a law requires otherwise.

sections.title: Governing law
